# MissingArrayInitialization

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `MissingArrayInitializationInspection`

Appending to a local array (`$list[] = …`) deep inside nested loops without
ever initialising it means the variable is undefined (`null`) when nothing is
appended, and its contents leak between outer iterations if it is meant to be
reset. The array should be initialised explicitly at the right place.

## Example

```php{5,6}
<?php
function collect(array $groups, $limit) {
    for ($n = 0; $n < $limit; ++$n) {
        do {
            $bucket[] = $n;
            $bucket[$n][] = $limit;
        } while (false);
    }

    foreach ($groups as $group) {
        $flat[] = $group;
    }

    $done = [];
    foreach ($groups as $group) {
        foreach ($group as $item) {
            $done[] = $item;
            $limit[] = $item;
            $group[] = 0;
            $this->seen[] = $item;
        }
    }

    return function ($extra) use ($done) {
        while (true) {
            foreach ($extra as $e) {
                $done[] = $e;
                $extra[] = $e;
            }
        }
    };
}

foreach ($a as $x) {
    foreach ($x as $y) {
        $global[] = $y;
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Array &#39;$bucket&#39; is never initialised; initialise it before the loops.</li>
<li>line 6: Array &#39;$bucket&#39; is never initialised; initialise it before the loops.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MissingArrayInitialization": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MissingArrayInitialization

/**
 * @noinspection MissingArrayInitializationInspection
 */
```
